thread:
Morgan: HyperLane proposal landed. 120 H100s. Options: full sea (12-16w) or air (3-5w). Air premium ~+27%/unit. They can hold RMA kit pool at FRA for quick swaps. PO on drive.

Sanjay: Cluster capacity question  can we accept a 48-unit air tranche in eu-west without impacting customer lanes?

Kevin: If we delay noncritical batch jobs we can free ~10% in Dedicated for 72h. Biggest risk is staging/backhaul scheduling  depot handoff windows must match our install crew.

Amira (HyperLane): Recommend a split: partial air for canary + sea for bulk. FRA depot hold gives 48-72h swap SLA for items under warranty (SLA addendum required). We can pre-assign serial ranges to speed intake.

Rachel: Quick cost note: air-only ~= +$450k. Example split (72 sea / 48 air) ~= +$180k + depot fees (~$12k/mo). CFO approval needed but seems defensible vs downtime risk.

Morgan: Proposal: 8-unit air canary to eu-west, remaining air/sea split for bulk. Ops: can you draft a canary roll plan and confirm install window? Also need RMA behavior confirmed: depot swap vs forwarder replacement.

Sanjay: I can schedule canary build in ~10-14 days after AWB + serials and routing OK. Sea bulk will route to AMS then to our staging (add ~5 business days for customs/kitting).

Amira (HyperLane): I'll DM AWB + serial CSV EOD. We can quote prepaid depot hold if you want earlier reservation; addendum required for swap SLA.

Kevin: Note on customs: some carriers request additional docs even with HS code 8471. ops-bot, flag HS doc checklist.

ops-bot: Added checklist item: "HS certificate + proof of purchase for FRA routing".

Morgan: Looping Legal for the SLA addendum and Eng for transient quota request (72h). PO snippet: 

```
PO: PO-98499
qty: 120 H100
split: 72 sea / 48 air (8-unit air canary)
eta-air-canary: 3-5w
eta-sea-bulk: 12-16w
rma-depot-hold: FRA, 20 kits, 90d (requires addendum)
```

Rachel: I'll assemble cost memo + simple risk matrix.

Amira (HyperLane): Manifest link + proforma AWB will be posted tonight. Ask if you want serial reservations earlier.

Sanjay: After AWB/serials, I'll publish canary install steps and request transient burst on Dedicated.

Morgan: Action items: 1) Amira send AWB/serials EOD 2) Legal review SLA addendum 3) Ops prep canary plan and transient quota request. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
